blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Those who wish to visit their departed loved ones at Libingan ng mga Bayani in Taguig City for Undas will have to prepare for a large crowd from Saturday (October 31) until All Saints’ Day on Sunday (November 1). The management of this cemetery is expecting more than 99,000 visitors. “We expect that the number of visitors will be the same [this year],” said Lt. Col. Joanne Paule Villareiz, commander of Task Group Pasasalamat under the Grave Services Unit of the Philippine Army’s Support Command.
